description: The chart represents the distribution of four categories across three difficulty levels: easy, medium, and hard. Each pie chart is divided into four slices, representing the categories N+K+, N-K+, N-K-, and N+K-. The easy chart has 55.4% green (N+K+), 38.3% yellow (N-K+), 4.6% orange (N-K-), and 1.7% red (N+K-); the medium chart has 58.8% green, 35.4% yellow, 4.0% orange, and 1.8% red; and the hard chart has 37.3% green, 37.9% orange, 18.1% yellow, and 6.7% red. The chart includes a legend on the right side, indicating the color corresponding to each category, and percentage labels are shown inside each slice. The slices are not visually emphasized or exploded, and the categories are not ordered in a particular way across the charts, but within each chart, the slices are arranged in a clockwise direction.
